IMPLEMENT THIS FEATURE END-TO-END, NOT JUST AN AUDIT.

Create a complete selectable race-track mode for the BMW M5 driving lab from current main.

Hard requirements:
- DEFAULT app launch/spawn remains the existing empty plane. Do not auto-load the track.
- Add an explicit start-menu environment selection so the user can choose Plane or the new Race Track.
- Track scene content must be isolated so plane mode remains visually/performance-wise clean.
- Preserve vehicle physics and all AGENTS.md / PHYSICS_CONVENTIONS.md / M5_VALIDATION.md invariants.
- Keep npm run build, npm run test:conventions, and npm run test:m5-validation:strict passing.

Creative direction C — driver's circuit first, spectacle second:
Build an 'insane' fictional circuit that is genuinely fun to lap repeatedly in a heavy high-power M5: distinct sectors, memorable corner identities, proper width, readable apexes, progressive radius turns, at least one long acceleration zone, one heavy-braking hairpin, high-speed esses, elevation compression/crest, a Laguna-style corkscrew or downhill switchback, bridge/underpass crossover, pit/start straight, curbs, runoff, guardrails/tire walls, braking markers, start lights/gantries, minimal but convincing grandstands/paddock buildings, terrain and trackside vegetation/rocks. Make every landmark help navigation.

Engineering expectations:
- Inspect current architecture and current ground/raycast assumptions first.
- Prefer a modular TrackEnvironment/world builder and clean integration into the existing start-menu flow.
- Continuous procedural asphalt surface with sensible normals/elevation and no obvious self-intersection artifacts where avoidable.
- Track-specific car spawn/grid position + heading; exact current plane spawn remains unchanged.
- Efficient WebGL: reuse materials/geometries and use instancing or batching for repeated dressing.
- Do not replace the physics engine or destabilize M5 validation.
- Include robust cleanup/disposal when switching back to plane mode if architecture supports switching at runtime.
- Patch must compile and validate independently.

Return the concrete complete code patch implementing the feature.
